svg.title: G7 crew states, senior and normal
svg.desc: Two stacked ribbons of hourly crew states over 30 days. Top: 215 senior crew; bottom: 210 normal crew. Bands: flying blue, deadhead red, 45-min turnaround yellow, 8h overnight rest orange, 48h home break purple, available grey. Both pools run at roughly half deployment at peak; normals carry more deadhead.
